propositions: Auto-deploy restarts the review-bot container during in-flight code reviews, causing teardown-corrupted reviews to cast fail-closed LLM-Review -1 votes that block the existing backfill recovery mechanism.

The shutdown drain timeout (45s) is much shorter than the per-review timeout (1200s), so reviews are cancelled before completion; raising DEFAULT_SHUTDOWN_DRAIN_SECONDS to 1200 and stop_grace_period to 1320s allows in-flight reviews to complete before termination.

Retryable coverage gaps (review-error, llm-unavailable, scanner, gate-disabled) should cast no vote instead of fail-closed -1, leaving the change vote-less so the backfill reconciler re-drives it without suppression.

A new review_attempts table (keyed change_id, revision) records failed attempts; after RETRYABLE_GAP_MAX_ATTEMPTS (default 3) consecutive retryable failures the voter escalates by casting fail-closed -1 with retries-exhausted note and emitting VOTER_ERROR.
Terminal outcomes (indeterminate, finding) and PASS remain unchanged; vote-less changes stay unsubmittable and must remain eligible for backfill reconciler recovery without posting to Gerrit.
